question: roads with max speed over 50 km/h
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, speed_limits[1].max_speed.value AS max_speed FROM lisbon_roads WHERE speed_limits[1].max_speed.value > 50

question: show sidewalks as WKT
sql: SELECT id, ST_AsText(geometry) AS geom_wkt FROM lisbon_roads WHERE subclass = 'sidewalk'

question: roundabout geometries as geojson
sql: SELECT id, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'tertiary' AND names.primary ILIKE '%rotunda%'

question: residential roads with unpaved surface
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, road_surface[1].value AS surface FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'residential' AND road_surface[1].value != 'paved'

question: start point of secondary roads
sql: SELECT id, ROUND(ST_X(ST_StartPoint(geometry))::NUMERIC, 5) AS start_lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_StartPoint(geometry))::NUMERIC, 5) AS start_lat FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'secondary'

question: road names containing 'Avenida'
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name FROM lisbon_roads WHERE names.primary ILIKE '%Avenida%'
